title: China’s Overcapacity Has a Mind of Its Own
gist: Lizzi C. Lee and Xiao Ma argue China's export juggernaut shows no sign of slowing, citing a tenfold rise in auto exports since 2020 and a record $119.1B August trade surplus. They contend overcapacity is not purely a product of top-down Beijing planning: the government is not fully in control and outcomes have exceeded what it intended.
